title: CraftStory — Turn Any Photo Into a Talking AI Video
excerpt: Create hyper-realistic talking videos from a single photo. Consistent AI personalities, expressive emotions, natural gestures, and 30+ languages.
content_html:

Photorealistic human video, powered by compact AI

Turn Any Photo Into a
Hyper-Realistic Video

Photorealistic talking videos with consistent personalities, expressive emotions, and natural gestures. Just upload a photo and type your script.

No credit card required

Featured In

UGC

Authentic user-generated content, at scale

Produce authentic-looking UGC at scale for ads, social media, and marketing campaigns. Diverse faces, languages, and styles on tap — without casting calls, shoots, or release forms.

  • Diverse cast of AI creators across age, ethnicity, and style
  • Native, idiomatic delivery in 30+ languages
  • Spin up A/B variants in minutes, not weeks

Product

Professional product videos on demand

Generate product demos, tutorials, and explainer videos as fast as your roadmap moves. Update messaging instantly — no reshoots, no studio bookings, no waiting on edits.

  • Consistent presenters across every launch and update
  • Localize for every market without re-recording
  • Iterate on copy and ship a new cut the same day

Learning & Development

Engaging training videos without a studio

Scale your L&D content library without scheduling a studio, camera crew, or talent. Keep the same trusted AI presenters across onboarding, compliance, and skills programs.

  • Long-form modules up to 30 minutes per clip
  • Refresh courses instantly when policies change
  • Plug into your LMS with consistent brand voice

✨

Hyper-Realistic Output

Our models produce videos indistinguishable from real footage. Natural skin texture, accurate lighting, and lifelike mouth movements that sync perfectly to any script.

🧑

Consistent Personalities

Your AI characters stay the same across every video. Same face, same identity — perfect for recurring presenters, brand ambassadors, and training series.

🎬

Videos Up to 30 Minutes

Go beyond short clips. Generate long-form content for training modules, product walkthroughs, and full presentations — all from a single photo.

0 minutes per video

✨

Video Agent

Just tell the agent what you want your video to be about. It writes the script, finds b-roll, adds infographics and subtitles, and casts your avatar — end-to-end, hands-off.

Need a tweak? Just chat with the agent — make any changes in plain English.

1

Upload a photo

Choose any face photo or pick from 100+ AI avatars. One image is all you need.

2

Type your script

Write your text or paste a script. Pick a voice and language from dozens of options.

3

Generate

Hit generate — get a studio-quality talking video with natural gestures in minutes.

Running UGC ads? Batch-generate creator-style ad variants from one photo with the AI UGC generator — here’s how to make UGC ads with AI.

What is CraftStory?

CraftStory is an AI video platform that turns a single photo into a hyper-realistic talking video, or creates a custom avatar of you from a short video. Add a script (or your own audio) and generate studio-quality video with natural gestures and lip-sync in 30+ languages — no camera or crew required.

Do I need a photo or a video?

Both work, for different things. To turn a single image into a talking video, a photo is enough (Model 2.0). To create a reusable, hyper-realistic custom avatar of yourself, record a short video of about 15 seconds.

How realistic are the videos?

Very. CraftStory produces photorealistic talking videos with natural skin texture, accurate lighting, expressive emotions, gestures, and precise lip-sync.

What languages are supported?

30+ languages with accurate lip-sync, plus voice cloning so your avatar can speak in your own voice.

How long can the videos be?

Up to 30 minutes from a single image.

Is there a free plan?

Yes. Start free with credits to make your first video — no credit card required. Create an account at app.craftstory.com.

Ready to create your
first AI video?

Start creating hyper-realistic videos in minutes. No credit card required.
